description: Literal find/replace within a note's text content; use for mid-paragraph tweaks the section-based tools can't target. Marks (bold, italic, code, etc.) are preserved on the surrounding text. ⚠ The match is literal-substring across every text leaf in the doc; an overly generic `find` (e.g. " a ") can rewrite the doc unrecognizably. Pick a phrase distinctive enough to land where you mean. By default replaces every occurrence; set `all: false` for first-only. Returns `{ replacements }` so you can sanity-check the count. `replace` can embed media by containing `![alt](attachment://<attachmentId>)` as a sole-line image - the id must come from `naumu_request_attachment_upload` presigned with this same `noteId`; an unresolvable or wrong-note id fails the whole write with a 400 naming the bad id.

all.description: Replace all occurrences (default true). Pass false to replace only the first.

find.description: Substring to search for. Literal - no regex.

replace.description: Replacement string. May be empty to delete the match.

name: naumu_note_find_replace
title: Find/Replace in Note
